title: A2A task cancellation has no native OIX v0.1 equivalent
purpose: Negative compatibility case: prevent a bridge from implying native cancellation support merely by inventing an OIX message type.

expected.description: OIX v0.1 defines no native cancellation message or operation. A bridge must not emit a fabricated core message type or claim cancellation succeeded. Any application-level cancellation convention needs its own versioned extension/profile, acknowledgement, authorization, and behavior contract.

limitations: Spec-level negative test only; no live endpoint is invoked.
A custom bridge extension is possible but is not OIX v0.1 core semantics.
No implementation conformance or certification claim.
